bio_en: Petros Seremjian was a haiduk who fought in the Van self-defence of 1896, firing calmly at Turkish gunners from a house in the Atarats quarter of Aygestan; his comrades called him the crown of their band's efforts that year. After four days of fighting the band withdrew to Mount Artos, mourning comrades killed in Hayots Dzor. He continued on the revolutionary path for six more years until he met a hero's death, as recorded in Droshak in September 1902.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Death year: #163 says Vardo opened a fund 'not a month after Petros's death' in Sharzhum 1901 no. 377.
